headline: Nevish Line Deadlocked After Heavy Exchanges; Stonecradle Post Left Vacant
war_summary: Nevish Line, reported six Warden posts to two Colonial at the last edition, now stands deadlocked at four apiece, with thirteen events in the past two hours and thirty-nine across the day; Grief Mother and Blackcoat Way have seen the sharpest work, and the latest filing arrived as this dispatch went to press. Stlican Shelf has swung back the other way, seven Colonial posts to two Warden where six and two stood before, Breaker Town the scene of repeated contests. Callahan's Passage, held Warden throughout but one unclaimed position earlier, now shows eight Warden posts against two Colonial, six events falling in two hours about Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage, where the guns have run near 612 Colonial and 620 Warden losses the hour. Stonecradle reports a post lying wholly unclaimed, with two Warden and six Colonial remaining. Palantine Berm has gone entirely Warden, seven posts, its exchanges cooled to five events in two hours. Weathered Expanse, leader of the day at twenty-seven events, has quieted to three, one Warden post against eight Colonial. Kuura Strand has fallen silent since midnight. No victor has been declared.
